title: Reading what the game is offering you
target: How to use the crosshair, the highlight and the indicators in Supermarket Simulator so you act on what the game is actually offering.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop with objects in it
A moment to look before you act

steps.do: Watch the crosshair rather than guessing what is usable.
steps.because: the game has a crosshair manager of its own (PlayerCrosshairManager)

steps.do: Look for the highlight when you are unsure whether something can be acted on.
steps.because: usable objects are highlighted by a manager of their own (HighlightManager)

steps.do: Check the indicator for what you are holding, separately from what you are looking at.
steps.because: the carried item has its own indicator (HoldingInteractionIndicator)

steps.do: Read the on-screen text when something happens.
steps.because: the game shows messages in words as well as in colour (InGameTextIndicator)

steps.do: Take the hint when a cart fills up rather than pushing on.
steps.because: a full cart has an indicator of its own (CartMaxedIndicator)

commonMistakes: Acting on something that was never usable.
Ignoring the indicator for what you are carrying.
Filling a cart and wondering why nothing else fits.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
